gui.field.stateFrameHelp: Empty: the whole texture, its animation playing. A number (from 0): only that square frame of a vertical strip, still.
gui.field.stateConditionHelp: Used when no state procedure is set: the first state whose logic procedure returns true is shown; a state without one always qualifies. None: nothing is drawn.
gui.field.stateNumberHelp: Number procedure read on the client that picks the state shown. Empty: the states' own conditions decide.
gui.field.stateValueHelp: State number: 0 is the first state, values outside the list stop at the first or last one. Percentage: 0 to 100 spread evenly over the states (a progress bar).
gui.field.updateTicksHelp: 0: the state is read every frame. A number: once every that many ticks (20 ticks = 1 second), so a state stays at least that long.
gui.field.restartAnimationHelp: On: when the shown state changes, its animation starts from its first frame. Off: all animations run on the game's clock.
gui.state.states: States: click one to show it on the canvas
gui.state.splitHint: Replaces the shown state with one state per frame of its strip, in order (for a progress bar driven by a percentage).
runClient.title: Run another client
runClient.hint: The client connects to this engine's running test server as soon as the game starts.
runClient.noServer: The test server is not running; start it with Build & run > Run server, or join later from the Multiplayer menu.
runClient.badName: A player name has 3 to 16 letters, digits or _.
runClient.taken: A client of {player} is already running.
connect.title: Connect an AI agent
connect.intro: AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, ...) work on a project through MCEdge's MCP server, and the app shows what they do in the Agents panel. Add MCEdge to your agent once with one of these. The agent starts MCEdge itself, in the background and without a window; Node.js is not needed.
connect.portable: This is the portable MCEdge: it runs from a temporary folder that is deleted when it closes, so the paths below stop working. Install MCEdge with the setup program to connect agents.
connect.noProject: No project is open: replace the placeholder with your project's folder, or open the project first.
connect.commandHint: Runs over stdio, with the environment variable {env}. One server works on one project folder.
connect.claudeHint: Run in a terminal; add --scope user to use it in every folder, or --scope project to share it in .mcp.json.
connect.json: Gemini CLI, Cursor and other clients
connect.jsonHint: The mcpServers block most clients read: Gemini CLI ~/.gemini/settings.json, Cursor .cursor/mcp.json, Claude Desktop claude_desktop_config.json. Merge it into the file's existing mcpServers.
